verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships an official CLI, documented on its own docs site for managing tenant configuration, automating tasks and integrating into development and deployment workflows, with a first-party GitHub repo confirmed by probe. A changelog entry announcing "Agent Mode for the Auth0 CLI" supports the AI-native angle. Missing for 10: details of what Agent Mode actually does (only a changelog title is evidenced), in-depth command or feature documentation in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use by AI agents.
